thread:
Sam W: Heads up — after yesterday's AWQ rollout for mistral-7b, some requests spiked tail latency and KV hit rate dropped.
Anjali P: saw that. reproducible on the nightly perf cluster? which workload did you run?
Sam W: quick repro: long chat sessions (seq ~2048) with many rollbacks, microbatch=1. profiler shows KV cache thrash, and kernel selector picks slow fp32 path for a subset of layers.
Mike R: any flamegraphs or traces? sounds like kernel mis-selection + prefetch thrash.
Sam W: pasted a minimal trace snippet from perf-bot below
perf-bot: trace_id=tr_20260312_001, top spans: kernel_select -> kv_fetch -> prefetch_eviction -> kernel_exec
Anjali P: can you paste the selector decision log? I want to see why it fell back to fp32.
Sam W: here's the selector tail (condensed):
```
layer=11 qtype=awq bitwidth=8 hw=ampere seq=2048 heads=32 kv_dim=64
metrics: latency_est=2.8ms kernel_opt=quantized_matmul
but: quant_score drops on RoPE_scale>1.1 -> fallback=fallback_fp32
```
Jen L: ah — the RoPE scaling heuristic triggers a safety fallback for layers with >1.1 scale when quant_score uncertainty high. For mistral we tuned that conservatively last quarter.
Mike R: right, but AWQ calibration for this model showed stable accuracy up to 1.25 in offline evals. selector threshold may be too tight for long sequences.
Anjali P: also KV eviction — prefetch currently uses global hotset=8192 tokens; with long seq+many heads we see headwise hotset thrash. lowering prefetch window might help.
Sam W: quick numbers from the cluster: baseline (pre-deploy AWQ): p99=118ms, p50=22ms. after AWQ rollout: p99=310ms, p50=26ms, KV hitrate dropped 72% -> 40%.
Mike R: that's big. suspect two orthogonal issues: (1) kernel fallback increases per-token time; (2) KV prefetch eviction loop thrashes and increases end-to-end latency.
Jen L: proposal: add temporary override to force quant path for layers 8-20 where offline eval shows low degradation, and reduce prefetch_hotset to 4096 for the workload. Also enable dynamic batch coalescing to reduce microbatch=1 overhead.
Anjali P: +1. we should run a quick A/B on nightly cluster: override flags {force_quant_layers: [8-20], prefetch_hotset: 4096, coop_coalesce: true}
Sam W: started A/B run 2281234575. initial results (50k requests): p99=135ms, p50=24ms, KV hitrate=68% — p99 improved massively but still above historic.
perf-bot: ab_test 2281234575 - control: p99=310ms, variant: p99=135ms, delta p99=-56.5%
Mike R: good improvements. what's the accuracy delta with forced quant layers?
Sam W: offline eval on calibration prompts: top-1 exact-match drop 0.6% (AWQ baseline) vs 0.2% with forced quant subset — within alert thresholds.
Jen L: good. next steps: (1) roll variant to >10% traffic on prod canary, (2) instrument selector confidence score logging, (3) update AWQ calibration to include long-seq/rope-scale scenarios.
Anjali P: I'll add a small change to kernel selector: raise RoPE scale safe_threshold from 1.1 -> 1.18 for mistral family and expose as per-model override. then re-run a micro-benchmark across seq=[512,1024,2048].
Mike R: also add a metric for "kv_eviction_rate" to console and alert if >20% over baseline.
Sam W: logging note: selector currently emits a one-line reason; expanding to include quant_score and fallback_cost_est helps triage. I'll send a tiny PR.
perf-bot: deploy pr/4578 to perf-nightly at 2026-03-12T09:12Z
Jen L: let's reconvene after the canary has 6 hours of traffic. thanks all.
Sam W: thanks — filing a short postmortem/notes in #eng-runtime docs folder after canary complete.
